explanation: The Almighty Creator who is the source of all things and stands above human authority.
A title for a sent messenger, especially Paul, who received his calling directly from Jesus Christ.
The message of salvation through the death and resurrection of Jesus Christ, given by God to all people.
A preposition indicating that something happens by means of or on the basis of another power or person.
The decision made in advance to call someone to a specific purpose, independent of human plans.
The act where God calls and chooses individuals for his service based on his will.
People who follow the Jewish religion and the law given through Moses in the Old Testament.
A set of religious rules and commands from God, often referred to as the Law of Moses or Torah.
An attitude characterized by respect for God and obedience to His will without relying on human traditions.
